repos.name: anthropics/claude-code
repos.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
repos.one_liner: An agentic CLI tool that integrates Claude directly into the terminal to automate coding tasks and codebase navigation.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-performance terminal interaction.
Utilizes Claude 3.5 Sonnet to execute complex coding tasks, git workflows, and debugging.
Designed for developers to offload routine maintenance and boilerplate generation to an autonomous agent.
Provides deep codebase context awareness to assist in refactoring and feature implementation.

repos.name: tangency-labs/solidcraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk Fusion 360 in pure Rust. Parametric 3D CAD for desktop, browser, and AI agents via MCP.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, open-source parametric 3D CAD engine built in Rust, designed for integration with AI agents.
bullets: Written in Rust for memory safety and high-performance geometric computation.
Supports cross-platform deployment across desktop, browser, and headless environments.
Features native support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable AI-driven design workflows.
Ideal for automated engineering tasks and programmatic 3D model generation.

repos.name: Ojhaharsh/30u30
repos.one_liner: A structured curriculum designed to master 90% of modern AI by analyzing 30 foundational research papers in 30 days.
bullets: Curated Python-based learning path focusing on the most impactful AI research.
Provides a systematic approach to understanding LLM architectures and agentic frameworks.
Accelerates technical literacy for finance professionals looking to implement AI in quantitative workflows.
Focuses on high-signal papers that define the current state of the art in machine learning.

repos.name: walkinglabs/learn-harness-engineering
repos.description: Harness engineering beginner tutorial, from 0 to 1
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, from-scratch tutorial series for mastering harness engineering and infrastructure automation.
bullets: TypeScript-based educational framework for building robust CI/CD and deployment pipelines.
Covers the full lifecycle of infrastructure engineering from initial setup to production scaling.
Provides practical, hands-on modules for developers to standardize their deployment environments.
Essential for DevOps and platform engineers aiming to improve infrastructure reliability.

repos.name: KnifeLemon/Filee
repos.description: Free, open-source file converter. Convert 180+ formats offline by drag & drop — images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP/HWPX, video, audio, e-books and archives. No upload, no Office needed.
repos.one_liner: A privacy-focused, offline file conversion utility supporting over 180 formats without requiring external cloud uploads.
bullets: Developed in C# as a lightweight, high-performance desktop application.
Enables secure, local processing of sensitive financial documents like Excel, PDF, and Word files.
Eliminates data privacy risks associated with cloud-based conversion services.
Useful for automating data ingestion pipelines where data sovereignty and security are paramount.
